name: Fan & Thermal Control
author: mittai17
description: Laptop & desktop CPU/GPU fan speed control and thermal monitoring. Features 3-level quick modes (Eco, Medium, Max), manual speed slider, and intelligent closed-loop temperature auto-regulation to maintain normal system temperatures.
